item.title: Silique 0.2.33
item.description:
English is now the default Silique interface language. Choose English or Polski during first-run setup or in Settings; the choice is remembered and applies immediately, including app-owned dialogs, update messages and Android widgets/search.
Existing notes, folders, tags, vaults and keys remain unchanged. New default titles and sample content use the selected language. Mixed-language clients retain identical synchronization/conflict data.
Operating-system/security/installer dialogs may use their own language. macOS remains a signed preview without Developer ID notarization; Windows has no Authenticode signature. No owner-device installation, personal test or interactive/alternate-administrator UAC test is claimed. Publication of this release was explicitly authorized without another owner approval; this is not a standing waiver for future releases.
Polski: dodano angielski jako język domyślny oraz zapamiętywany wybór English / Polski przy pierwszym uruchomieniu i w Ustawieniach. Zmiana działa na bieżąco. Istniejące notatki, dane i klucze pozostają bez zmian.
